segments.text: In this town, on your tenth birthday, the Animal Saint gives you a companion for life.
Strong kids get wolves. Brave kids get eagles. Your animal decides your whole future.
On my tenth birthday, I got a turtle. A tiny one. The whole town laughed.
But I didn't care. I named him Pebble. I fed him every morning, and I carried him everywhere.
Then came Jax's birthday. The Saint raised his staff, and the sky turned red. Jax got a dragon.
Everyone called him the next great hero. And Mia, the girl I had liked forever, started holding his hand.
So I trained. Every single day. Pebble and me, in the rain, in the snow, until the sun went down.
Then came the Grand Tournament. Every kid, every animal, one champion.
Jax and his dragon burned through every round. And somehow, Pebble and I kept winning too.
Now it's the final. A turtle, against a dragon. The whole town is watching.
Jax smiled. His dragon opened its mouth. And Pebble started to glow.
